description: Golden dataset over data/sample_docs: 30 answerable question/answer/source triples and 5 unanswerable questions. source_page is null for DOCX/TXT, where citations use the section instead.

questions.question: What is the nominal pressure of the RA-HP 450 pump?
questions.expected_answer: 280 bar (peak pressure 350 bar for max. 1 s).

questions.question: What torque must be used for the mounting flange bolts of the RA-HP 450?
questions.expected_answer: 110 Nm (M12 x 1.75, strength class 10.9).

questions.question: What is the factory setting of the pressure controller DR on the RA-HP 450?
questions.expected_answer: 250 bar; the setting range is 50 to 280 bar.

questions.question: How often should the suction and return filters of the RA-HP 450 be replaced?
questions.expected_answer: Every 2000 operating hours or every 12 months.

questions.question: How much leakage at the shaft seal of the hydraulic pump is considered normal?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 3 drops per hour is normal and needs no action.

questions.question: Welche Reinheitsklasse ist für die Hydraulikflüssigkeit der RA-HP 450 vorgeschrieben?
Wie hoch ist der Wirkungsgrad des Netzteils RA-PS 24/40?
questions.expected_answer: Typisch 94,5 % bei Volllast.

questions.question: Wie lange kann das RA-PS 24/40 den Power Boost von 60 A liefern?
questions.expected_answer: Maximal 5 Sekunden.

questions.question: Welcher Abstand muss oberhalb und unterhalb des Netzteils RA-PS 24/40 frei bleiben?
questions.expected_answer: Mindestens 50 mm oben und unten (seitlich mindestens 15 mm).

questions.question: Wie viele RA-PS 24/40 Netzteile dürfen parallel geschaltet werden?
questions.expected_answer: Bis zu vier Geräte.

questions.question: At what internal temperature does the RA-PS 24/40 power supply switch off?
questions.expected_answer: At 85 °C (the Temp LED blinks on overtemperature).

questions.question: Wie lange läuft der Rahmenliefervertrag und wie ist die Kündigungsfrist?
questions.expected_answer: Feste Laufzeit von 36 Monaten ab 01.01.2026, verlängert sich um 12 Monate, Kündigungsfrist 6 Monate zum Laufzeitende.

questions.question: Wie viel Skonto gibt es bei Zahlung innerhalb von 14 Tagen?
questions.expected_answer: 3 % Skonto (30 Tage: 2 %, 60 Tage netto).

questions.question: Wie hoch ist die Vertragsstrafe bei Lieferverzug?
questions.expected_answer: 0,5 Prozent des Nettoauftragswertes pro angefangener Woche, höchstens 5 Prozent.

questions.question: Welche Deckungssumme muss die Haftpflichtversicherung des Lieferanten haben?
questions.expected_answer: Mindestens 5 Millionen Euro je Schadensfall.

questions.question: Welcher Gerichtsstand gilt für den Rahmenliefervertrag?
questions.expected_answer: Freiburg im Breisgau; es gilt deutsches Recht unter Ausschluss des UN-Kaufrechts.

questions.question: How long is the standard warranty for power supplies of the RA-PS series?
questions.expected_answer: 36 months from delivery (extended: 60 months with 6 % surcharge).

questions.question: What fee is charged for an unjustified warranty claim?
questions.expected_answer: An inspection fee of EUR 180 plus return shipping.

questions.question: How quickly is an RMA number issued after a warranty claim?
questions.expected_answer: Within 2 working days.

questions.question: How fast do customers with a Silver service contract get an advance replacement unit?
questions.expected_answer: It is shipped within 48 hours.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length according to the IT security guideline?
questions.expected_answer: 14 characters.

questions.question: After how many minutes of inactivity do company devices lock automatically?
questions.expected_answer: After 5 minutes.

questions.question: How soon must a suspected security incident be reported and to whom?
questions.expected_answer: Immediately, at the latest within 24 hours, to the IT service desk (extension 4444) or security@rheintal-antriebstechnik.example.

questions.question: Wie hoch ist die Hotel-Obergrenze pro Nacht in München?
questions.expected_answer: 180 Euro (sonst 120 Euro inklusive Frühstück).

questions.question: Wie viel wird pro Kilometer bei Nutzung des Privat-Pkw erstattet?
questions.expected_answer: 0,30 Euro je Kilometer ab dem 21. Kilometer, maximal 400 km pro Fahrt.

questions.question: Innerhalb welcher Frist muss die Reisekostenabrechnung eingereicht werden?
questions.expected_answer: Innerhalb von 4 Wochen nach Reiseende; nach 6 Monaten ist keine Erstattung mehr möglich.

questions.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get per year?
questions.expected_answer: 30 days per year (pro rata for part-time).

questions.question: How many hours per week may working students work during the lecture period?
questions.expected_answer: A maximum of 20 hours per week (up to 40 hours during semester breaks).

questions.question: What is the nitrogen pre-charge pressure of the accumulator on test bench HTB-3?
questions.expected_answer: 90 bar at 20 °C; below 80 bar the bladder is leaking.

questions.question: What is the permissible deviation when calibrating the flow meter FT-1?
questions.expected_answer: 0.5 percent of the measured value.
